decision_description: The FIELDWISE concept is recorded as aligned to the HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 call for the purposes of the Phase 2 concept-refinement gate. All eight Tier 2B expected outcomes (EO-01 through EO-08) are mapped to specific Tier 3 concept evidence in training_and_career_development.md with validation_status Confirmed, and the topic_mapping.json artifact records those eight mappings. Scope coverage is complete across all structural scope elements (SR-01..SR-08) and call constraints (CC-01..CC-13), each resolved to covered or not_applicable, and the concept_refinement_summary scope_conflict_log is empty. Strategic differentiation is established (movement from retrospective predictive accuracy to operational decision value via the six transitions and the four-step MATE->MVCRI->AgroVIR->DrR validation ladder). The concept-vs-Tier-2B thematic scope question raised in scope_check entry scope_check_concept_refiner_2026-08-13T12:00:00Z (topic-scope-check_7acc143b.json) remains a separate operator-surfaced item and is not merged into or resolved by this alignment record; MSCA-PF Tier 2B defines only structural, not thematic, scope, so no thematic scope conflict is created against Tier 2B by this decision.
alternatives_considered: Defer the concept_alignment decision until the thematic in-scope question (scope_check entry topic-scope-check_7acc143b.json) is resolved by the operator. Rejected because that question concerns the absence of any thematic Tier 2B boundary for MSCA-PF, not an unresolved conflict between the concept and Tier 2B; the Phase 2 gate condition addresses expected-outcome alignment and scope conflicts, both of which are satisfied.

Record only partial alignment on the grounds that EO-06 carries a 'global attractiveness' vocabulary gap and five host-capacity fields are Unresolved in the brief. Rejected because EO-06 is nonetheless mapped Confirmed with present concept evidence and the vocabulary gap and host-capacity Unresolved fields are flagged in the summary rather than blocking alignment; they are downstream host-input items, not a scope or expected-outcome misalignment.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 (Phase 2 gate condition: topic mapping confirmed, concept vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes, no unresolved scope conflicts between concept and Tier 2B); Tier 2B expected_outcomes.json (EO-01..EO-08)
rationale: The Phase 2 gate condition requires a confirmed topic mapping, concept vocabulary aligned with Tier 2B expected outcomes, an articulated strategic differentiation within the call scope, and no unresolved scope conflicts between the concept and Tier 2B. Each element is evidenced in durable Tier 4/Tier 3 artifacts: topic_mapping.json (eight confirmed mappings), concept_refinement_summary.json (topic_mapping_rationale all Confirmed, scope_coverage complete, empty scope_conflict_log, strategic_differentiation stated). Recording this decision to the Tier 4 decision log makes the alignment determination durable per CLAUDE.md §9.4 rather than held only in agent memory, and names the governing authority under which the determination was taken so it is traceable for downstream phases.
